Welcome to the clinic, I see you've mentioned unusual beliefs about telepathic communication with animals; can you describe exactly what you experience and for how long?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Belief in telepathic communication with animals. I also have Ingestion of Peruvian herbs, No improvement with self-medication. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pyelonephritis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That previous suggestion of pyelonephritis does not align with your reported beliefs; can you tell me specifically which animals you believe are communicating with you and what they are saying? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns, social withdrawal, or hearing voices that are not related to the animals?

REQUEST TEST: Auditory_Hallucination_Screening
REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Brain

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Misidentification Syndrome (specifically involving beliefs of telepathic communication with animals).
